messages:
devon-devex: Noticed a bunch of onboarding tickets today tied to the `ml-starters` README. Two quick issues: the curl example uses `Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_KEY` but our SDKs use `Bearer` and the example env var in docker-compose is `REDWOOD_API_KEY` so copy/paste fails with 401s.

mia.docs: Ah, thanks for flagging. Can you drop the exact problematic snippets? I can push a README patch.

riley-engineer: Repro: clone repo, up docker-compose, run the curl in the README -> 401. The compose file has `environment: - REDWOOD_API_KEY=${REDWOOD_API_KEY}` but README shows `export REDWOOD_KEY=...` and curl header `Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_KEY`.

devon-devex: Here's current curl from README (misleading):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-mini","input":"hi"}'
```

And the JS sample later expects `new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` so two different env names and header styles.

jamal-se: I'll open a small PR to: (1) standardize env var to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, (2) switch curl to `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY`, (3) add a one-line troubleshooting tip: "If you get 401, confirm your env var name and Authorization header (Bearer vs Token)."

mia.docs: Please also add language-specific quick examples side-by-side (curl, JS, Go) so users don't have to translate shapes. A before/after in the PR description helps reviewers.

jamal-se: Good call. I'll include a minimal smoke test in CI that runs the curl against a tiny mock server (so we catch future drift). Also adding a note about retries: the README mentions "SDK retries on transient errors" which is vague; I'll change to: "SDKs provide limited automatic retries for transient errors; configure retry/backoff explicitly in production via SDK options."

riley-engineer: One more tiny fix: the Go snippet uses `client.New(ctx, apiKey)` but our Go SDK ctor is `newclient.NewClient(ctx, newclient.WithAPIKey(apiKey))` — I'll inline the correct call in the Go example.

ci-bot: PR opened by jamal-se: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ml-starters/pull/88 — CI: lint + sample-smoke-test started.

mia.docs: Thanks! After merge I'll update the quickstart landing page to point to the fixed sample and add a short note in the changelog so we can link tickets to the update.

devon-devex: Nice, this should remove the most common first-day friction. :slightly_smiling_face:
